title: FrameTrail configuration
description: Instance configuration: _data/config.json. On a public instance the file is readable by anyone, so it must not hold secrets. Missing keys take the defaults given here. Unknown keys are allowed; writers keep them. See docs/INTEGRATION.md ("Writing the Settings") and docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.

defaultTheme.description: Colour theme: a built-in theme id or one defined in custom.css. Empty means classic. A hypervideo's config.theme overrides it.

overviewTitle.description: What this instance calls its overview, e.g. a project name; shown as text. Empty means the localized "Overview".

overviewMode.description: How the overview presents the hypervideos. Takes effect on reload.

overviewShowSearchBar.description: Show a search field for the overview in the title bar.

defaultLanguage.description: Language code of the user interface. Takes effect on reload.

allowUploads.description: Allow file uploads. Only false (the boolean) forbids them.

alwaysForceLogin.description: Make the instance private: nothing can be read without signing in. Only true (the boolean) does this. Server mode only.

userNeedsConfirmation.description: New accounts need an administrator's approval.

captureUserTraces.description: Record user traces. Takes effect on reload.

userTracesStartAction.description: User action that starts a trace, e.g. "UserLogin". Empty means no trace ever starts.

userTracesEndAction.description: User action that ends a trace, e.g. "UserLogout".

userAvatars.description: Profile pictures. off: initials only. local: pictures from this instance's resources. cache: also provider pictures, fetched once and stored here. remote: also provider pictures, loaded by the visitor's browser from the provider.

userColorCollection.description: Colours users can pick, as hex without "#".

allowCaching.description: Let the browser cache data requests.

externalAuth.description: External authentication, public half. This file is public: secrets (hmacSecret, clientSecret) belong in _data/.auth/config.php, which is merged over this object. Active only when mode and provider are both set. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.

mode.description: interactive: FrameTrail shows a sign-in wall. transparent: identity is the platform's to give.

provider.description: token: a signed token bridge. oidc: an OpenID Connect relying party.

providerId.description: Tags the accounts this provider creates and namespaces their subjects.

label.description: The platform's name, used in sign-in texts.

manageUsersUrl.description: The platform's user roster; replaces the user management dialog for admins.

renewUrl.description: Platform URL loaded in a hidden frame for silent re-authentication. Same-site only.

canLogout.description: false removes the Logout menu entry.

sessionCookie.description: Name of the platform's session cookie, compared on every request. Never sent to the browser.

maxSessionAge.description: Absolute session bound in seconds, clamped to 300…2592000; 0 disables it. Never sent to the browser.

issuer.description: token: exact match for the token's iss. oidc: discovery base.

audience.description: token: exact match for the token's aud.

publicKey.description: token: PEM public key for RS256 and EdDSA. Not secret.

skewSeconds.description: token: tolerated clock skew in seconds.

maxAgeSeconds.description: token: maximum token lifetime in seconds.

redirectUri.description: oidc: redirect URI registered with the provider.

adminClaim.description: oidc: claim that carries admin membership.

adminValue.description: oidc: value in adminClaim that means admin.

cacheSeconds.description: oidc: discovery and JWKS cache lifetime in seconds.

externalSettings.description: Hands the instance settings to the hosting platform: present (any object), the settings dialog is gone and FrameTrail refuses to write config.json and custom.css. See docs/INTEGRATION.md.

manageUrl.description: Where administrators manage the instance; linked from the user menu if it is http(s) or root-relative.

extensions.description: Extensions this instance loads, in order. Requires a FrameTrail release with extension support; older releases ignore the key.

name.description: Name of the extension, as it registers itself.

script.description: Script to load: a relative path on the same origin, e.g. "extensions/hello/hello.js".

style.description: Stylesheet to load: a relative path on the same origin.

settings.description: Public settings handed to the extension untouched. FrameTrail neither reads nor validates them. This file is public: secrets belong in _data/.auth/<name>.php.

lastchanged.description: Compare-and-swap token: when the file was last saved through FrameTrail, in milliseconds since 1970.

theme.description: Legacy. Former name of defaultTheme, renamed when read.

overviewMap.description: Legacy. The overview map, stored here before 2.0. Read when hypervideos/_index.json has none and moved there by the first map save.
